Pedestrian Counts

An accurate and reliable pedestrian count survey can provide you with highly valuable information regarding the general foot traffic on the premises. Depending on the kind of business that you are into, this information can be translated into potential client count, or you could use the data to enhance the conditions of a sidewalk or the entrance of your building to facilitate the appearance and other factors. By obtaining focused information on pedestrian counts in the areas where crowds tend to gather, you can utilize the information to analyze traffic volume, junction improvements and so forth.

Parking surveys

The precise data collection methods that we implement in order to conduct accurate parking surveys ensure that we obtain precise information on existing parking trends in a particular zone including the duration of parking, specific on-street and off-street parking information, associated demand and stress. Other information that can be obtained include a review of controlled parking areas, management of parking stress, adequacy of the zone, impact on the area, etc. The revenue of the area used for parking and associated finances can also be determined. The information collected on non-controlled parking areas can be useful in determining any need for action.

Public transport surveys

Effective and comprehensive information regarding all different kinds of public transport are obtained through different means and this information includes data collected from railways, bus terminals, major airports and so on. The collected data ultimately goes into improving the public transport system by providing valuable resources to the planning authorities to work on public transport and shall be able to convert the obtained data into valuable tools in the form of manually collected information as well as video surveillance and data obtained electronically. The information is available in crisp yet detailed formats facilitating use by different industries and businesses.

Pedestrian road side interview surveys

Ultimately, if you are in the service industry, it is all about improving the lives of the people around you and through dedicated pedestrian roadside interviews, we have gathered all the information that you need to understand and analyze their demands and requirements. This information is highly valuable to city planners and new businesses opening up in the area as you can gain valuable insight into your potential clientele. Depending on various factors, a particular space can be transformed suitably so that it can be both profitable and helpful to the population prevailing in the area.

Household surveys

These kinds of surveys prove to be valuable to numerous businesses as well as organizations working on public welfare and are conducted through meticulous processes which are intensive and quite expensive to conduct on account of the special training that our executives need to go through in order to attain maximum levels of professionalism and keeping their safety as a prime concern. We strictly abide by the Market Research Society Code of Conduct and ensure that these surveys are conducted in a manner that causes least amount of inconvenience to the public whilst obtaining precise and useful information.

Cycle Count Surveys

Over the past years, there has been a dramatic increase in the number of people who use cycles as a mode of transport. Department for Transport’s (DfT) ‘Road Traffic Estimates Great Britain 2020’ statistical release, reporting that pedal cycle traffic was 45.7% above 2019 levels. To determine the potential of cycling and to financially enhance infrastructure schemes, there is a need to give priority to conducting cycle surveys. Cycle surveys enable the study of travel durations, origin-destination analysis and parking utilisation. Fast Track Surveys develop enhanced survey tools and conduct any method of classified cycle counts.

Market research

We cover almost every type of setting that you can imagine in order to be able to maximize our focus group coverage and obtain unbiased results by involving a large enough population to ensure we have as much data as possible. The surveys are conducted on the streets as well as in strategically selected locations including shopping centers and other areas such as sporting arenas. Besides conducting face-to-face interviews, other modes of survey include questionnaires, telephone surveys, etc. and businesses of different kinds can utilize the data obtained to design and market their products or services effectively.

PRIVACY POLICY

Introduction

Your privacy is important to us and we believe it is important for you to know what personal data we at Fast Track Surveys, are collecting from you, why do we collect it, how we use it and what rights you might be entitled to as a data subject or consumer.Fast Track Surveys is committed to ensuring that your privacy is protected. Should we ask you to provide certain information when using this website, then you can be assured that it will only be used in accordance with this privacy statement.

Fast Track Surveys may change this policy from time to time by updating this page. You should check this page to ensure that you are updated with any changes.

How we use your personal data

Fast Track Surveys might collect distinct kinds of personal data in numerous different ways and use it for a number of different purposes: To confirm access to our website and online services Typically, you can visit our website https://www.fastracksurveys.co.uk/ and its affiliate websites on the World Wide Web without telling us who you are. Our web servers or Affiliates who offer analytics and performance enhancement services may collect: IP addresses, Fast Trackting system details, device and connectivity details, and/or language settings Name and Phone number Contact information including email address Demographic information such as postcode, preferences and interests Other information relevant to customer surveys and/or offers This information is collected in order to measure the number of visits, average time spent on the site, pages viewed and related information. Fast Track Surveys uses this information to measure the site usage, improve content and to ensure safety and security as well as enhance performance and user experience of the website. Subscriptions to our promotional communications.

If you sign up to receive marketing communications from Fast Track Surveys we may reach out to you via email, telephone or any other means of communication. To promote the Fast Track Surveys brand, products, initiatives and values with marketing communications.

Fast Track Surveys has a strong legitimate interest in promoting its brand, products, initiatives and values. In order to further such goals, we process personal data about our business contacts including existing and potential Fast Track Surveys clients, third parties and intermediaries. Fast Track Surveys interacts within the course of doing business. Fast Track Surveys may collect details about you including name, contact details. We might process such data by using software or platforms which allow us to handle our client relationships. Data collected by us is used in part to administer, manage and develop our business and services; like identifying existing and potential client business requirements, analysing and evaluating the forte of our communications with certain business contacts, performing analytics including to produce metrics such as relationship maps for our business leadership and limited profiling for the purposes of helping us to develop and offer appropriate products and services to existing and potential clients. Analytics may be performed by us using algorithms which help us analyse and rank interactions with you depending on interaction frequency and duration. Fast Track Surveys could also send you marketing communications and surveys in order to carry out market research or provide information to you about us and our services when we have a reason to believe that it would be of interest to you in your professional capacity. You can opt-out from receiving such communications at any time using the contact us form on https://www.fastracksurveys.co.uk/ or affiliate websites where you had given your personal data, or by just clicking on the unsubscribe link included at the bottom of emails. From time to time, we may use your name, quotes, pictures or videos to promote and amplify Fast Track Surveys brand and activities. You will receive appropriate additional information from us about the usage of your personal data in any such case.

Why might Fast Track Surveys share your personal data with third parties?

Where required by law, we may share your personal data with third parties, wherever it is necessary for one of the activities mentioned above or in case we have another legitimate legal basis in doing so. Where obliged by the law, we may ask for your consent before transferring data to third parties that are not part of the HCI group of companies.

Which third-party service providers process my personal data?

“Third parties” comprises all third-party service providers (including designated agents and contractors) and other entities within our group. The subsequent activities may be conducted by third-party service providers: data storage and analytics, event organizers and caterers, hosting and other internet services, marketing research and campaign management. In order to protect your personal data in line with our policies, all our third-party service providers are required to take appropriate security measures. We do not permit our third-party service providers to make use of your personal data for their own purposes. Third-party service provides are only allowed to process your personal data in accordance with our instructions and applicable law and for specified purposes only. We might also require sharing your personal data to comply with the law or with regulators.

When will Opera share your personal data with other entities in the group?

As a part of our regular reporting activities on company performance, we may share your personal data with other entities with Fast Track team In the context of a business reorganization or group restructuring exercise. System maintenance support and hosting of data and when needed, in order to perform one of the activities listed above. It is necessary for other entities in the Fast Track team to take suitable security measures to protect your personal data in line with our policies.

Security

We are committed to ensuring that your information is secure. In order to prevent unauthorised access or disclosure we have put in place suitable physical, electronic and managerial procedures to safeguard and secure the information we collect online.

How we will keep your information safe

Appropriate technical, organizational and security measures have been put in place to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered or disclosed. Furthermore, we limit accessibility to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors and other third parties who have a business need to know. They are subject to a duty of confidentiality and will only process your personal data on our instructions.Procedures have been put in place to deal with any suspected data security breach and you will be notified and any applicable regulator of a suspected breach where it is legally required to do so.

How long we will keep your information

Your personal data is retained only if necessary, to accomplish the purposes we collected it for, inclusive of the purposes of fulfilling any legal, accounting or reporting requirements. In certain circumstances we might anonymize your personal data so that it is no longer associated with you, in such a scenario we may use such information without further notice to you.

Links to other websites

Our website may contain links to other websites of interest. However, once you have used these links to leave our site, you should note that we do not have any control over that other website. Therefore, we cannot be responsible for the protection and privacy of any information which you provide whilst visiting such sites and such sites are not governed by this privacy statement. You should exercise caution and look at the privacy statement applicable to the website in question.
